explanations.joint_gains: I increased Kp on both joints until the arm moved toward the target quickly enough. Then I increased Kd to reduce overshooting and shaking. Finally, I slightly increased Ki to help correct the remaining error and make the arm settle closer to the target.
explanations.gravity_comp: Gravity compensation added another force we had to account for and especially in the link between the shoulder and the arm.

checkin.note: I increased the Kp on both the shoulder and elbow until the arm moved toward the target quickly enough. The arm was then overshooting and shaking, so I increased Kd on both joints to help stabilize the movement. Finally, the arm was stopping slightly away from the target, so I increased Ki a little on both controllers to reduce the remaining error and help the arm settle.
